prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1444; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's Narrative: On arrival at the scene in Baytown, Texas, I observed two vehicles in the eastbound lanes with significant front-end contact. Driver 1 was operating the northbound sedan and stated that the other vehicle crossed into their lane while attempting to pass a slower truck. Driver 2 was operating the southbound SUV and stated that they were braking and steered right to avoid impact, but contact still occurred. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of the SUV and remained on scene. Both vehicles sustained front bumper and headlamp damage consistent with a low-speed collision. Airbags did not deploy in either vehicle. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain and stated they did not wish to be transported by ambulance at this time. Driver 2 reported no visible injuries. Skid marks were not observed. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Citation issued to Driver 2 for failure to maintain a single lane. Vehicles were removed from the roadway without incident.
